note: Bridger-Teton NF (Blackrock Ranger District) campground on Buffalo Valley Road above the Buffalo Fork River, 17 miles east of Moran Junction. Also a stock campground: seven sites have corrals and hitch rails, with a stock tank and large corrals by the loop. After the September 15 closing the gate stays open and camping is free, with water off, toilets locked and no trash service. --Claude
